newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee seen slipping, consolidating.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee seen slipping, consolidating.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE coffee futures should drop further and then consolidate to correct an extremely overbought relative strength index (RSI) before trying to move higher again, analysts said on Wednesday.
July coffee was called to open down $50, adding to losses made on Tuesday, when July closed at $2,075.
"The market still needs to consolidate and it could correct a bit lower," said Darren Gurner, analyst at Sucden.
Gurner pointed to an extremely overbought RSI, which jumped to more than 90 percent after July rallied strongly on Monday.

Gurner attributed Monday's surge in London to investors' jumping into a cheaper robusta market after New York arabicas became too expensive to buy. New York's arabicas have led most of coffee's rally this year.
Now he said it was time for the market to correct lower and digest gains.
Initial support rested at $2,060 with further support at $2,000. Below that, a gap remained unfilled between the May 15 high of $1,940 and the next day's low of $1,973.
Gurner did not expect that to be filled. But if July fell to fill the gap, the technical picture could change and coffee might start to look slightly less bullish.
